findings.detail: Affiliated-investment activity rows are being admitted as holdings/cost rows even though the table columns are roll-forward fair value activity, duplicating SOI positions.
The filing's Debt & Equity Investments cost anchor is 809,253,307, while the extracted cost population sums to 1,279,714,700.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation decides the item. The raw schedule reports Total Debt & Equity Investments at amortized cost of 809,253,307, while the reviewed extracted cost sum is 1,279,714,700. The filing separately presents cash equivalents and short-term investments outside that debt/equity anchor, and table 28 is an affiliated-investment roll-forward with fair-value activity columns rather than an amortized-cost holdings schedule. The same Legacy Companies investment appears in the SOI and in the roll-forward, so the overshoot is a real extraction population/double-count error rather than a bad source anchor.
